title: Representative and adjunction normalization of scalar pullback comparison
statement:
Let $h:\operatorname{Sh}(C_X)\to\operatorname{Sh}(C_Y)$ be a morphism of topoi on sites small in the module universe [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A_Y\to B_Y$ be a map of commutative ring sheaves and set $A_X=h^{-1}A_Y$, $B_X=h^{-1}B_Y$. Write $h_R^*=h^{-1}$ on $R$-modules, $r_T$ for scalar restriction, and $T_T=B_T\otimes_{A_T}^{\mathbf L}-$ on ordinary unbounded module-sheaf derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. Use sheafified balanced tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. The ordinary $B_X$-linear comparison
$$\chi_h:h_B^*(B_Y\otimes_{A_Y}P)\longrightarrow B_X\otimes_{A_X}h_A^*P$$
is the coequalizer comparison induced by inverse image of the two balancing arrows. It is invertible and preserves $p\mapsto1\otimes p$.

For every flat-term K-flat complex $P$ [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules, def-pc-kflat-complex], the inverse of $Q(\chi_h)_P$, under the canonical K-flat representative identifications, is exactly the scalar-adjunction mate $\theta_h:T_Xh_A^*\to h_B^*T_Y$ of the action identification $h_A^*r_Y=r_Xh_B^*$. Thus this mate is an isomorphism on the entire unbounded derived category. For two composable such inverse images $f,g$, using the canonical ring and inverse-image composition maps,
$$\theta_{gf}=(f_B^*\theta_g)\circ(\theta_f g_A^*).$$
The comparison for the identity inverse image is the identity. No flatness of $A_Y\to B_Y$ is assumed.
